I was driving home on the main road in League City, Texas, when the car in front of me slowed and I mvoed to follow

an hour my neck was stiff and sore, and I have since been diagnosed with a neck strain. I have described the events

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
